name: Tracking Alpha
summary: Pre-launch tool for discovering and following US cash merger-arbitrage deals, with sourced updates, deadlines and scenario calculations. Waitlist open.

name: TickerReplay
summary: TickerReplay is a post-trade journal for stocks and options that rebuilds trades from broker executions, so a vertical, an iron condor or a roll stays one trade with one P&L instead of a separate row per leg. It imports CSVs from Interactive Brokers, tastytrade, thinkorswim and Robinhood or syncs a linked brokerage, and reports win rate, expectancy, profit factor and R multiples, excluding trades whose risk is unknown rather than estimating it.
